title: Directives
description: Schema for directives.yaml — a node's directive (rules/instructions) context. Directives are keyed and composed by specificity: the most-specific node wins per key, and composition filters directives by the node's kind (D3) so a docs-only leaf never inherits coding rules or their tokens.

version.description: Schema version of this directives file.

directives.description: The directives declared at this node.

directive.description: A single directive: a keyed rule or instruction with a composition operation and a set of tags it applies to.

key.description: Dotted key identifying what this directive governs (e.g. api.versioning or security.transport-encryption). Segments are kebab-case; the most-specific node's directive for a given key wins during composition.

op.description: Composition operation: 'set' replaces any inherited value for this key, 'extend' appends to it, 'suppress' removes it for this node and its descendants.

applies_to.description: Tags this directive applies to. During composition, kept only if it intersects the node's kind (D3).

text.description: The directive's content. Required unless op is 'suppress'.
